mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in > 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1.4 million units signals strong consumer confidence and rising demand for housing, which correlates with broader economic expansion and positive equity market sentiment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1400.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0, following a prior rise above 102.0, signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reflects weakening demand and rising recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 after prior INDPRO > 102.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal a persistent inflationary environment that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive monetary policy, which increases real discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS are rising, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 685,000 million dollars, combined with rising industrial production (INDPRO), signals strong underlying demand momentum that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 685000.0 and INDPRO > 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.7% and a rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 157,000 thousand signals a labor market that is both tight and expanding, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.7 and PAYEMS > 157000.0, or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 22,800 billion dollars, combined with rising residential investment (HOUST), signals a strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 22800 and HOUST > 1370, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
